claim: In the HWA laboratory, the Dynamic Workload Console (DWC) could not be installed because no DWC installer image was available; the installed image provides only the MDM component plus DWC database helper files. The DWC/Graphical Designer validation remains pending.
supporting_quote: Only dblighttool DWC database helper files and FileUpdateDwcList exist; no DWC installer image is present.
notes: DWC is a separate component requiring its own installer; Graphical Designer validation was deferred.
